articles.title: Myanmar participates in HADR Exercise held in India
articles.summary: A delegation of Myanmar Tatmadaw (military) personnel recently participated in India's Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief Exercise (HADR-2026). Held in the Tamil Nadu and Puducherry Naval Area in Chennai, the joint exercise aimed to enhance multinational coordination and capabilities for effective disaster response operations. This participation highlights regional defence cooperation in leveraging military resources for humanitarian aid and disaster mitigation efforts.

articles.title: Russia pounds power facilities around Kyiv, damages major bridge

The strikes highlight Russia's strategy to cripple Ukraine's critical infrastructure amidst the ongoing war, significantly impacting civilian life and resilience during winter.
